title: Dali operator slips into capital deficit

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The operator of discount grocery chain Dali Everyday Grocery returned to a P1.03 billion capital deficit in 2025, as mounting losses prompted its auditor to flag uncertainty about its ability to continue as a going concern. Hard Discount Philippines Inc. posted a P1.83-billion net loss last year, narrower than the previous year’s P1.97 billion, despite sales climbing 52.29 percent to P51.66 billion. READ: Dali Everyday Grocery operator faces uncertainty amid mounting losses Accumulated losses reached P7.07 billion, up 34.92 percent from P5.24 billion in 2024.
